claim: Founder item 89 (2026-09-28, draft PR #494, verbatim label "Guard PR first, then delete (Recommended)"): scripts/check_windowed_figures.py's /team PageSpec names every non-test file under apps/web/src/pages/team that calls a react-query hook, and the guard itself refuses (exit 2) when one is unnamed: `query_tree=_TEAM_TREE` walks both halves, and `every_query_read=True` refuses a query call it cannot parse or a body whose key it cannot read. FormerStaff.tsx, SendGrantsSection.tsx and useHouseAreas.ts (4 calls) were the unnamed three; W6 now reads their keys, including the undotted factories grantKeys(restaurantId), areasKey(rid) and awayKey(rid). The four legacy files under pages/team/command/ are `retiring`: checked like renderers while any source file is left there, not read once none is, so #494's deletion of that directory no longer makes the guard exit 2. Measured 2026-09-28 on fix/windowed-guard-team-rebuilt: guard exit 0 on origin/main's tree (23 /team keys read) and on feat/cutover-manifest-trial's tree (15 read, legacy half reported RETIRED); --self-test 116/116. #494 carries an OPEN twin of this id; it must drop or resolve it when it merges main.
verify: for f in $(grep -rlwE --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' 'use(Suspense)?(Infinite)?Quer(y|ies)' apps/web/src/pages/team | grep -vE '\.(test|spec|stories)\.tsx?$'); do grep -qF "\"$(basename "$f")\"" scripts/check_windowed_figures.py || exit 1; done; grep -qx '        query_tree=_TEAM_TREE,' scripts/check_windowed_figures.py && grep -qx '        every_query_read=True,' scripts/check_windowed_figures.py
